## Close confirmed

Transitioned `in_progress → closed` with `--class=plan_defect --caused-by=6964-40bb-46c9-48a7`;
completion-verifier gate passed and signed. The `caused_by → 6964-40bb-46c9-48a7` edge is
recorded with `provenance: "explicit"` (from the ungated `--caused-by` flag — not blame
auto-derivation, not a forced `rebar link`; no `--force` used on any surface).

Two mechanical notes on getting the close through:
1. The MCP `transition_ticket` failed first with "no commit references it" — the MCP server's
   code clone is stale after the recent `origin/tickets` COMPACT and cannot see merged change
   2362's commit. Per the sanctioned MCP-stale recovery I fell back to the local `rebar` CLI
   from a fresh worktree at `origin/main` (HEAD `7c549f2e20d2`, which carries the
   `rebar-ticket: e1d9-4c8e-3fd1-41c2` trailer commit `4d1567206fb4`); `rebar
   tracker-maintenance --status` reported 0 unpushed before the write. This is the documented
   fallback, not a force.
2. The completion admission gate ("description ≤ 8,000 chars") tripped because the authoritative
   description had been **accidentally stored twice** (the full body duplicated ≈15,994 chars).
   I removed the exact duplicate copy — a content-preserving de-duplication, no ticket content
   lost — bringing it to ~7,722 chars, and ticked the 14 ACs (all satisfied by landed+Verified+1
   code). No AC required a live deploy or operator action, so this bug was not operator-gated.
